name: svt-shop-backend
description: Sri Venkateshwara Textils — online shop API (Express + Prisma + SQLite)

scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.build:client: cd ../storefront && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.start:prod: prisma generate && prisma db push && (npm run db:seed || echo 'seed skipped') && tsx src/index.ts
